name: Age-related Dementia Downgrade
description: If the MRI model detects Alzheimer's but the patient is very young (< 30), it is highly unlikely. Downgrading confidence.

name: APOE ε4 Negative Protective Adjustment
description: If patient is APOE ε4 Negative, the likelihood of Alzheimer's is slightly reduced.

name: APOE ε4 Homozygous Risk Adjustment
description: If patient is APOE ε4 Homozygous, the risk of Alzheimer's is elevated.

name: BRCA Mutation Tumor Risk Boost
description: BRCA mutations can elevate risk for secondary brain tumors. Increasing confidence.

name: Previous Cancer Metastasis Risk
description: History of Lung or Breast cancer significantly increases risk of metastatic brain tumors.
